license_required.quote: no person may practice podiatry, designate himself or herself as a podiatrist, use or assume the title "doctor of surgical chiropody", "doctor of podiatry"or "doctor of podiatric medicine", or append to the person's name the words or letters "doctor", "Dr.", "D.S.C.", "D.P.M.", "foot doctor", "foot specialist" or any other title, letters or designation which represents or may tend to represent the person as a podiatrist unless the person is licensed under this subchapter.

issuing_authority.quote: the affiliated credentialing board shall grant a license as a podiatrist to a person who does all of the following

name.quote: "Affiliated credentialing board" means the podiatry affiliated credentialing board.

type.quote: "Affiliated credentialing board" means the podiatry affiliated credentialing board.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Safety and Professional Services
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of safety and professional services.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine or equivalent degree from an approved school of podiatric medicine and surgery
degree_required.quote: That the applicant is a graduate of a school of podiatric medicine and surgery approved by the affiliated credentialing board and possesses a diploma from such school conferring the degree of doctor of podiatric medicine, or equivalent degree as determined by the affiliated credentialing board

degree_level.quote: possesses a diploma from such school conferring the degree of doctor of podiatric medicine, or equivalent degree as determined by the affiliated credentialing board

school_approval_basis.quote: a school of podiatric medicine and surgery approved by the affiliated credentialing board

credential_pegged.quote: possesses a diploma from such school conferring the degree of doctor of podiatric medicine, or equivalent degree as determined by the affiliated credentialing board

required.quote: That the applicant has completed 2 years of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board or one year of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board if the one-year postgraduate training was completed by June 1, 2010.

experience_source.quote: That the applicant has completed 2 years of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board

duration.quote: 2 years of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board

kind.quote: completed 2 years of postgraduate training in a program approved by the affiliated credentialing board

exams.name: Podiatrist licensure examination
exams.notes: Written or oral tests requiring applicant to demonstrate minimum competency in subjects substantially related to the practice of podiatry. Applicant may be reexamined not more than twice; further examination requires reapplication and additional education or training.
exams.quote: examinations shall consist of written or oral tests, or both, requiring an applicant to demonstrate minimum competency in subjects substantially related to the practice of podiatry

interval_years.quote: Podiatrist: November 1 of each even-numbered year.

required.quote: Renewal applications shall be submitted to the department on a form provided by the department and shall be accompanied by all of the following: ... (b) Proof of completion of continuing education requirements in s. 448.665.

available.quote: The affiliated credentialing board may waive the requirement under sub. (1) (d) 1. for an applicant who establishes, to the satisfaction of the affiliated credentialing board, all of the following: ... That he or she is licensed as a podiatrist by another licensing jurisdiction in the United States.

requirements.value: Applicant must be a graduate of a podiatry school, licensed as a podiatrist by another U.S. jurisdiction, the other jurisdiction required the applicant to graduate from an approved or equivalency-evaluated school, and the applicant has actively practiced podiatry under that license for at least 3 years immediately preceding the application date.
requirements.quote: That he or she has actively practiced podiatry, under the license issued by the other licensing jurisdiction in the United States, for at least 3 years immediately preceding the date of his or her application.

exists.quote: "Affiliated credentialing board" means the podiatry affiliated credentialing board.

is_mandatory.quote: no person may practice podiatry, designate himself or herself as a podiatrist

title_protection.quote: no person may practice podiatry, designate himself or herself as a podiatrist, use or assume the title "doctor of surgical chiropody", "doctor of podiatry"or "doctor of podiatric medicine", or append to the person's name the words or letters "doctor", "Dr.", "D.S.C.", "D.P.M.", "foot doctor", "foot specialist" or any other title, letters or designation which represents or may tend to represent the person as a podiatrist unless the person is licensed under this subchapter.

scope_protection.quote: no person may practice podiatry ... unless the person is licensed under this subchapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act or attempted act of commission or omission defined as unprofessional conduct by the affiliated credentialing board by rule, or acting in violation of ch. 450 or 961.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: "Unprofessional conduct" means an act or attempted act of commission or omission, as defined by the affiliated credentialing board by rule under s. 448.695 (1), or an act by a podiatrist in violation of ch. 450 or 961.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatry without a license under the subchapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a person who practices podiatry without having a license under this subchapter may be liable for malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving, directly or indirectly, any fee, commission, rebate or other compensation for referring patients or for professional services not personally rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No licensee may give or receive, directly or indirectly, to or from any other person any fee, commission, rebate or other form of compensation or anything of value for sending, referring or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a licensee in a professional capacity, or for any professional services not actually rendered personally by the licensee or at the licensee's direction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to render an individual statement or account of charges directly to the patient, separate from any statement by any other provider.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a licensee who renders any podiatric service or assistance ... for which a charge is made to a patient, shall ... render an individual statement or account of the charge directly to the patient, distinct and separate from any statement or account by any other podiatrist, physician, physician assistant, advanced practice registered nurse, or other person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging more than the actual amount charged by the state laboratory of hygiene for services performed by that laboratory.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee who charges a patient, other person or 3rd-party payer for services performed by the state laboratory of hygiene shall identify the actual amount charged by the state laboratory of hygiene and shall restrict charges for those services to that amount.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being certified by the Department of Revenue as liable for delinquent taxes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the department shall deny an application for an initial credential or credential renewal or revoke a credential if ... The department of revenue certifies under s. 73.0301 that the applicant or credential holder is liable for delinquent taxes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being certified by the Department of Workforce Development as liable for delinquent unemployment insurance contributions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the department shall deny an application for an initial credential or credential renewal or revoke a credential if ... The department of workforce development certifies under s. 108.227 that the applicant or credential holder is liable for delinquent unemployment insurance contributions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being delinquent in paying support or failing to comply with a subpoena or warrant related to support or paternity proceedings.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the department shall restrict, limit, or suspend a credential or deny an application for an initial credential if the credential holder or applicant is delinquent in paying support or fails to comply, after appropriate notice, with a subpoena or warrant issued by the department of children and families

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond, to the satisfaction of the department or board, within 30 days to a request for information in connection with an investigation of alleged misconduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the department, or the appropriate credentialing board or other board in the department, may reprimand a credential holder, or may deny, limit, suspend, or revoke a credential, if the credential holder fails to respond, to the satisfaction of the department, credentialing board, or other board in the department, within 30 days to a request for information from the department, credentialing board, or other board in the department in connection with an investigation of alleged misconduct of the credential holder.

definition_quote.value: "Podiatry" or "podiatric medicine and surgery" means that branch or system of the practice of medicine and surgery that involves treating the sick which is limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle, but does not include the use of a general anesthetic unless administered by or under the direction of a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatry" or "podiatric medicine and surgery" means that branch or system of the practice of medicine and surgery that involves treating the sick which is limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle, but does not include the use of a general anesthetic unless administered by or under the direction of a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II.

methods_authorized.quote: that branch or system of the practice of medicine and surgery that involves treating the sick which is limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle

anesthesia_authority.quote: does not include the use of a general anesthetic unless administered by or under the direction of a person licensed to practice medicine and surgery under subch. II.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: limited to conditions affecting the foot and ankle

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A person assisting a podiatrist in practice under the direct, on-premises supervision of the podiatrist.

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: A person assisting a podiatrist in practice under the direct, on-premises supervision of the podiatrist.

opioid_prescribing_rules_required.quote: The medical examining board, the physician assistant affiliated credentialing board, the podiatry affiliated credentialing board, the board of nursing, the dentistry examining board, and the optometry examining board shall, by November 1 of each year, submit a report to the persons specified in subd. 2. that does all of the following: a. Details proactive efforts taken by the board to address the issue of opioid abuse.

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A physician assistant who is acting under the supervision and direction of a podiatrist, subject to s. 448.975 (2) (a) 2m.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse who is providing nonsurgical patient services as directed, supervised, and inspected by a podiatrist who has the power to direct, decide, and oversee the implementation of the patient services rendered.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: The department shall promulgate rules specifying a procedure for addressing allegations that a credential holder has practiced while impaired by alcohol or other drugs or that his or her ability to practice is impaired by alcohol or other drugs, and for assisting a credential holder who requests to participate in the procedure.
